concerns.text: T002 requires the FR-018 selection-bias assessment comparing Mixed vs. pure groups on 'comment_density' and 'issue_severity' distributions, but those columns are computed only in T003 (compute_metrics.py) into processed_prs.csv; T002's input/output is classified_prs.csv, which does not contain them. As written the task is not executable — either move the selection-bias assessment to a post-T003 task or specify that classify_provenance.py computes these interim metrics itself.

T003 bundles two full scripts (compute_metrics.py AND outlier_filter.py), five output files, and a test suite into one task — too coarse for deterministic execution. Split into separate tasks for metric computation/SSoT and for the filter variants so each has a single deliverable and verification.

Test locations disagree across artifacts: plan.md specifies root-level 'tests/test_classify.py' etc., while tasks specify 'code/tests/test_classify.py'. T010's verification ('pytest code/tests/') only matches the tasks version; an implementer following plan.md's structure would fail T010's check. Align the paths.

T004 is very dense (power analysis, normality checks, two companion tests, Bonferroni, chi-square, synthetic benchmark, schema-conformant output, tests) — consider splitting the synthetic-benchmark effect-size validation (FR-005) into its own task with its own verification line for cleaner executability.
